theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s r h
  simp only [ValidRequest] at h
  simp only [step]
  have h_eq : (if h1 : r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧ r.actor ∈ s.users then
    match h2 : r.kind with
    | .move => if h3 : allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true then (Outcome.ok, doMove s r) else (Outcome.rejected, s)
    | .edit => if h3 : s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft then (Outcome.ok, doEdit s r) else (Outcome.rejected, s)
    else (Outcome.rejected, s)) = (Outcome.rejected, s) := by
    by_cases h1 : r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧ r.actor ∈ s.users
    · simp only [dif_pos h1]
      cases hk : r.kind with
      | move =>
        simp only [hk]
        by_cases h3 : allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true
        · simp only [dif_pos h3]
          exfalso; apply h
          exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2, fun _ => h3, fun heq => by simp [hk] at heq⟩
        · simp only [dif_neg h3]
      | edit =>
        simp only [hk]
        by_cases h3 : s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft
        · simp only [dif_pos h3]
          exfalso; apply h
          exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2, fun heq => by simp [hk] at heq, fun _ => h3⟩
        · simp only [dif_neg h3]
    · simp only [dif_neg h1]
  exact h_eq

theorem doMove_status_other (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) (h : d ≠ r.doc) : (doMove s r).status d = s.status d := by
  simp only [doMove]
  simp [show (d == r.doc) = false from by simp [beq_iff_eq, h]]

theorem doMove_content_other (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : (doMove s r).content d = s.content d := by
  simp only [doMove]

theorem doEdit_status_other (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : (doEdit s r).status d = s.status d := by
  simp only [doEdit]

theorem doEdit_content_other (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) (h : d ≠ r.doc) : (doEdit s r).content d = s.content d := by
  simp only [doEdit]
  simp [show (d == r.doc) = false from by simp [beq_iff_eq, h]]

theorem req_single_doc : SingleDoc step := by
  intro s r hok d hne
  have hs : (step s r).1 = Outcome.ok := hok
  unfold step at hs
  by_cases h1 : r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧ r.actor ∈ s.users
  · rw [dif_pos h1] at hs
    cases hk : r.kind with
    | move =>
      rw [hk] at hs
      by_cases h3 : allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true
      · rw [dif_pos h3] at hs
        have hstep : step s r = (Outcome.ok, doMove s r) := by unfold step; rw [dif_pos h1, hk, dif_pos h3]
        rw [hstep]
        exact ⟨doMove_status_other s r d hne, doMove_content_other s r d⟩
      · rw [dif_neg h3] at hs; simp at hs
    | edit =>
      rw [hk] at hs
      by_cases h3 : s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft
      · rw [dif_pos h3] at hs
        have hstep : step s r = (Outcome.ok, doEdit s r) := by unfold step; rw [dif_pos h1, hk, dif_pos h3]
        rw [hstep]
        exact ⟨doEdit_status_other s r d, doEdit_content_other s r d hne⟩
      · rw [dif_neg h3] at hs; simp at hs
  · rw [dif_neg h1] at hs; simp at hs

theorem req_effects : Effects step := by
  intro s r hok
  simp only [step] at hok ⊢
  by_cases hmem : r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧ r.actor ∈ s.users
  · rw [dif_pos hmem] at hok ⊢
    cases hk : r.kind with
    | move =>
      simp only [hk] at hok ⊢
      have hall : allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true := by
        by_contra hc
        have heq : (if h3 : allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true then (Outcome.ok, doMove s r) else (Outcome.rejected, s)).fst = Outcome.rejected := by simp [hc]
        rw [heq] at hok; simp at hok
      rw [dif_pos hall] at hok ⊢
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro d; simp only [expectedStatus, hk, true_and]; by_cases hdd : d = r.doc <;> simp_all [doMove, hdd]
      · intro d; simp only [expectedContent, hk, show ¬(Kind.move = Kind.edit ∧ d = r.doc) from by simp, false_and, ↓reduceIte, doMove]
      · simp only [expectedAudit, hk, ↓reduceIte, doMove]
    | edit =>
      simp only [hk] at hok ⊢
      have hauth : s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft := by
        by_contra hc
        have heq : (if h3 : s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft then (Outcome.ok, doEdit s r) else (Outcome.rejected, s)).fst = Outcome.rejected := by simp [hc]
        rw [heq] at hok; simp at hok
      rw [dif_pos hauth] at hok ⊢
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro d; simp only [expectedStatus, hk, show ¬(Kind.edit = Kind.move ∧ d = r.doc) from by simp, false_and, ↓reduceIte, doEdit]
      · intro d; simp only [expectedContent, hk, true_and]; by_cases hdd : d = r.doc <;> simp_all [doEdit, hdd]
      · simp only [expectedAudit, hk, ↓reduceIte, doEdit, show (Kind.edit = Kind.move) = False from by simp]
  · rw [dif_neg hmem] at hok; simp at hok
